notes.title: Riddledale - Homecoming
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]Hello fellow Cat-Lovers! [/b][/p][p]We are thrilled to share brand-new content from [i]Riddledale[/i]! It’s been a while since we last released anything about our huge adventure game. This trailer marks a big comeback for our beloved and ambitious RPG.[/p][p]Dive deeper into the island’s mysteries, meet funny characters, and experience the atmosphere like never before. This trailer offers a fresh glimpse of the journey ahead.[/p][p]Want to be part of the adventure early? Join our community on [url="https://www.riddledale.com"]www.Riddledale.com[/url] for a chance to participate in upcoming betas and stay updated on all things [i]Riddledale[/i].[/p][p]Watch the trailer now on our Steam page and share your thoughts!

[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support!
— The Catnip-Lab Team
